slides.texte_overlay:
things that instantly make
you more interesting

a hobby nobody expects

take up something unusual, like fencing, pottery or beekeeping. people are always curious about someone with a hobby they've never heard anyone talk about before.

real opinions about books

read a few books that truly move you and form real thoughts about them. people love talking to someone who reads widely and actually thinks about what they read.

telling stories well

practise telling short stories with a beginning, a twist and an ending. a good storyteller is magnetic at any table, and it's a skill absolutely anyone can learn.

knowing strange facts

odd facts are the fastest way to become interesting, and collecting one a day takes only minutes. one strange fact can carry an entire conversation when things go quiet.
slides.texte_sophia:
knowing strange facts

collect odd facts, like why cats purr. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and 5 minutes of strange facts is the fastest way to become interesting to anyone.

slides.texte_overlay:
curiosity about others

ask people about their lives and really listen to their answers. the most interesting people are almost always the ones most genuinely interested in everyone else.
